Caribbean Climate Challenges

See how our mattresses are specifically engineered to withstand Caribbean conditions

Climate ChallengeStandard MattressesComfort Sleep Hotel Line
High Humidity (75-95%)
Year-round moisture exposure
Foam degradation within 18-24 months, mold growth in layers, odor development
Moisture-resistant foam maintains integrity 5+ years, antimicrobial protection
Tropical Heat (28-32°C)
Consistent warm temperatures
Heat retention causes guest discomfort, accelerated material breakdown
Advanced cooling gel technology, enhanced airflow channels keep guests comfortable
Salt Air Exposure
Coastal property corrosion
Steel springs rust within 2-3 years, fabric degradation, structural failure
Corrosion-resistant coated springs, marine-grade fabrics rated for coastal use
High Guest Turnover
300+ nights per year usage
Visible sagging by year 2, edge collapse, uneven support surfaces
High-density foam tested to 90%+ occupancy, reinforced edge support maintains shape
Dust Mites & Allergens
Tropical breeding conditions
Rapid dust mite colonization, allergen accumulation, guest complaints
Hypoallergenic materials, antimicrobial treatment, dust mite resistant barriers
Commercial Laundering
Frequent high-temp washing
Cover shrinkage, zipper failure, fabric wear after 100+ washes
Pre-shrunk commercial-grade fabrics, industrial zippers, stain-resistant treatments
